filters.label: PGA Min Envelope Value
filters.description: Filter PGA events with envelope_value (linear broadband contrast envelope value at the peak frame, computed by the percentile-gated detector's find_peaks call) below the threshold. The envelope_value is a per-event diagnostic stamped on every event alongside prominence; it tracks the absolute height of the peak in the contrast-summed attack envelope, while prominence tracks the peak's vertical distance to the local contour line. Sister filter to pga_min_prominence: envelope_value drops events whose peak didn't reach a minimum absolute level (catches the very-low-energy FPs that the prominence filter sometimes misses on the rising edge of a strike), while prominence drops events whose peak is short relative to its immediate neighbors. Both are useful; envelope_value is a better 'is this a real strike at all' test, prominence is a better 'is this a clean isolated strike' test. Default 1000 catches the floor — real toms / snare / hihat / cymbals strikes produce envelope_value in the 5000-15000 range on the calibrated projects, FPs and low-energy noise are typically < 3000. Set to 0 to disable.

filters.label: PGA Min Prominence
filters.description: Filter PGA events with prominence (scipy find_peaks prominence on the broadband contrast-summed envelope) below the threshold. Catches noise events with no real attack. As of 2026-06-19 this is the only WebUI-exposed PGA filter — the slider is rendered for all five stems (toms, snare, hihat, kick, cymbals).

filters.label: PGA Min Combined Score (warble)
filters.description: Filter PGA events with combined_score below the threshold. combined_score = prominence (scipy find_peaks prominence on the Δ5 signal) × delta5_stability (min of the next 5 Δ5 values divided by the peak Δ5). Sign-bearing: positive means a real sustained strike, negative means a warble spike (single-frame Δ5 transient from stem-splitter demuxing, no sustained rise). On Metallica hihat (project 10): 100% precision at threshold 0 (all 528 FPs have combined_score ≤ 0, all 225 real hits have combined_score > 0). Default 0 = 'warble separator'; lower (e.g. -100) is more permissive and catches some borderline cases; 0 is the recommended starting point. 2026-06-26: added after data exploration showed combined_score is a perfect discriminator on the cymbals and hihat stems tested so far. Use together with (or in place of) pga_min_envelope_value for stems where the envelope_value filter is killing too many quiet-but-real onsets.

filters.label: Min Decay Col-Min (dB)
filters.description: Filter PGA events with decay_col_min_median_db below the threshold. Catches single-frame noise pops with no sustained ring. Empirically: real toms strikes -60 to -84 dB, noise pops -84 to -90 dB. -80 dB is the safe cut between the two clusters. 2026-06-19: the WebUI no longer exposes a slider for this filter (did not perform well in practice) but the Python pipeline still applies it as part of the layered PGA filter chain. Set `expose_in_webui: true` to re-enable the slider.

filters.label: Attack Rise Max (ms)
filters.description: Filter PGA events with attack_rise_ms above the threshold. Catches wire-tail / step-back FPs that the prominence + decay_col_min filters miss — these have real-looking attack but the high-res STFT detects they 'step back' to a previous attack, producing an unusually long 10-90% rise time. Empirically (project 6, Taylor Swift toms): all real hits have attack_rise < 20ms; FPs cluster at 100-500ms. 2026-06-19: the WebUI no longer exposes a slider for this filter (did not perform well in practice — the previous-hit ringing made the rise walk stretch across hits; the 2026-06-18 fix bounds the walk to the previous event but the filter still has edge cases). The Python pipeline still applies it as part of the layered PGA filter chain. Set `expose_in_webui: true` to re-enable the slider.
